battle.name: 第十三次敘利亞戰役
battle.brief: 公元前1441年，埃及第十八王朝法老圖特摩斯三世在王曆三十八年再度北進，兵鋒指向約旦河東岸的努哈謝草原，進行一次規模不大的邊境襲擊，向游牧首領截取牲畜與人質。卡面這件埃及月牙劍是近衛與車兵的舊式佩劍，外彎單刃，砍入之後不必拔刃，在小隊突擊與近身格鬥中仍在裝備之列。

kit.name: 埃及月牙劍
kit.history: 外彎的單刃劍，砍下去不用拔。它比直劍更早出現在埃及人的手上。

countries: 交戰的兩方，是埃及新王國第十八王朝，與其北面的黎凡特—敘利亞諸邦聯盟。埃及一方以法老圖特摩斯三世為最高統帥，王室直轄的神兵車隊駐於全軍中央，步兵主體是各郡徵集的埃及籍持矛兵與弓手，在編制上隸屬於軍隊書記官與阿姆人亞細亞裔軍官；車兵分成王室供應與諸省供應的輕型雙輪戰車兩級，每車配御者與射手各一，車上除弓與箭袋外，另備長矛與一柄近身用的月牙劍。軍需自孟菲斯沿尼羅河用船運到卡爾納克與西奈口岸，再轉駱駝隊與驢車北運。北面的聯盟沒有統一統帥：卡爾基什、阿拉普、卡圖納、圖尼普、卡爾基米什等城邦各有國王與兵馬，名義上奉米坦尼的偉大王為宗主，實際各自為政，靠聯盟會議協調出兵；米坦尼是胡里安人國家，統治層為印歐語系的王族，另有數量不多的貴族階層掌握兵權。本次遠征的實際目標卻不在大城，而在約旦河東岸的努哈謝：一片半遊牧人口聚居的草原地帶，約在今約旦河東岸的泰勒哈梅一帶，名義上歸阿姆吉的盟友一方，實際長期游離於埃及與聯盟的約束之外，住著以武裝騎隊劫掠為生的部族首領。
countriesEn: The two belligerents were the Egyptian New Kingdom of the Eighteenth Dynasty and the league of Levantine and Syrian city-states to its north. On the Egyptian side the supreme commander was Pharaoh Thutmose III, with the royal escort of chariots stationed in the centre of the host; the infantry core was Egyptian spearmen and archers levied from the provinces, subordinated to the army scribes and to Amu officers of Asiatic descent; the chariot arm was split between the royal contingent and light two-wheeled cars provided by the nomes, each carrying a driver and an archer, and besides the bow and the quiver the car held a spear and a khopesh for work at close quarters. Supply moved by boat down the Nile from Memphis to Karnak and to the frontier depots of Sinai, and was then carried north by camel train and donkey cart. The coalition in the north had no single commander: Kadesh, Aleppo, Qatna, Tunip, Carchemish and the other city-states each had their own king and troops, nominally ranged under the great king of Mitanni but in practice autonomous, coordinating their levies through a league council; Mitanni was a Hurrian country ruled by a dynasty of Indo-Aryan descent, with a small layer of nobles holding the military power. The real object of this expedition, however, was not a great city but Nuhašše on the east bank of the Jordan: a steppe region inhabited by semi-nomadic people, roughly around Tell el-Hammeh today, nominally held by a partner of Amurru and in practice long beyond the discipline of either Egypt or the coalition, and occupied by chiefs whose armed bands lived by plunder.
people: 全場的核心仍是法老圖特摩斯三世，他登基已三十八年，北方這條戰線正是他一手經營出來的。這位國王早年以梅吉多一役確立了對黎凡特的宗主權，之後把每年的北征編入王曆年表，編號一路排到第十七次；第十三次正是這套制度化年年出征的成熟形態——在外交與儀式上是一次對北方盟邦的例行敲打，在戰術上則是一場規模不大的邊境行動。北面的對手一般認為是米坦尼王圖施拉塔，他的王國以幼發拉底河上游的瓦舒卡尼為根據，與埃及之間靠貢賦、互贈人質與書信維持；赫梯方面在位的是穆爾西里二世，他與埃及的往來書信構成了北方外交的另一條線，第十次遠征之後赫梯甚至向埃及遞交貢物。真正執行這場任務的是一批不具名的人物：卡爾納克神廟的書記官把出征日期、繳獲清單與獻俘場面逐條刻下來；被稱為預言者的王室使者往來於各城邦之間，核對人質與歲貢的交付；車隊的御者多出自王室子弟與近衛，射手則受過長期的騎射與御車訓練；近衛與梅德雅那樣出身於沙漠巡邏的武裝人員，隨身佩的是月牙劍，遇上散兵與狹窄地形時比直劍好使。努哈謝一線的地方首領與其半遊牧武裝隊伍，則是這場行動真正的對手。必須說明的是，本場戰役的指揮者姓名、接戰地點與交戰經過，在現存材料中都沒有留下記載。
peopleEn: The hinge of the whole affair is still Pharaoh Thutmose III, thirty-eight years onto his reign, and the northern front was his own creation. Having established his suzerainty over the Levant at Megiddo in his youth, he thereafter wrote every northern expedition into the regnal annals, and the numbering runs on to the seventeenth; the thirteenth campaign is the fully developed form of that institutional, year-by-year campaigning: a routine rebuke to the northern client states in the language of diplomacy and ritual, and a small frontier operation in tactical terms. The opponent in the north is generally held to be Tushratta, king of Mitanni, whose state was based at Washukanni on the upper Euphrates and whose relations with Egypt ran on tribute, exchanged hostages and letters; on the Hittite side the king on the throne was Mursili II, and his correspondence with Egypt formed a second channel of northern diplomacy, the Hatti even delivering tribute to Egypt after the tenth campaign. The men who actually carried out this operation are nameless: the scribes of the temple of Karnak cut the dates of departure, the lists of booty and the scenes of presenting prisoners into the stone; the royal envoys called the heralds passed between the city-states checking the handover of hostages and annual tribute; the drivers of the chariots were largely royal princes and members of the guard, while the archers had long training in riding, shooting and driving; the guard and men of the Medjay, recruited from desert patrols, carried the khopesh, which served them better than a straight sword against scattered men and in narrow ground. The local chiefs of Nuhašše and their semi-nomadic armed bands were the real opposing force. It has to be said that the names of the commanders, the place of contact and the course of the fighting in this campaign are all missing from the surviving material.
kits: 本卡兵器是埃及月牙劍：一柄外彎的單刃劍，刃口朝外凸出，砍入之後不必把劍拔出，劍尖可用來刺穿盾面與甲縫。它的形制源於早王朝的曲柄斧，比直劍更早出現在埃及人手上，中王國之後定形，到新王國仍是埃及最常見的單手兵器之一。卡爾納克的浮雕留下過這件武器的樣子：圖特摩斯三世的戰役圖中，身後的侍衛手持月牙劍，弓手在車上取弓姿態，步行軍卒在車側佩劍。前一千四百四十一年，它在軍中仍占著位置：近衛與梅德雅把月牙劍作為貼身兵器，車上的射手在不便用弓時也可改持月牙劍近身格鬥，法老本人的佩劍則是經過裝飾的儀仗之物。同一時期埃及步兵的標準配備還包括直刃長矛、銅刃短斧與彎鉤斧、複合弓與銅鏃箭、皮革或銅製頭盔、小型圓盾，貴族與近衛另有銅鱗甲；車兵用輕型雙輪車、六輻木輪與一對馬，弓為複合弓，備長矛與短劍。攻城裝備在這一系的浮雕裡也有記載：繞輪的攻城塔、以槓桿操作的撞錘、掘壞牆基的坑道，埃及的攻城技藝在地中海屬最早的一批。努哈謝那樣的草原勢力則以馬弓、輕裝與機動見長，車兵與重裝步兵都少，正面衝突能力有限，因而多以游走、劫掠與退避應對。
kitsEn: The weapon on this card is the Egyptian khopesh: a single-edged sword curved outward, with the cutting edge on the convex side, so that once it has struck it need not be pulled back out, and with a point that can be used to pierce a shield face or the gap between plates of armour. Its form derives from the curved axe of the Early Dynastic period; it appeared on Egyptian hands before the straight sword and was established in form after the Middle Kingdom, and by the New Kingdom it was still among the commonest single-handed weapons in Egypt. The weapon is preserved in the reliefs of Karnak: in the campaign scenes of Thutmose III the attendants behind the king carry khopeshes, the archers take their stance on the cars and the infantry on foot wear swords at the side of the chariots. In 1441 BC it still held its place in the army: the guard and the Medjay carried the khopesh as their close-combat arm, the archers on the cars could take up a khopesh when the bow was awkward, and the pharaoh's own sword was a decorated piece of ceremonial equipment. The standard Egyptian infantry kit of the same period also included straight spears, copper-edged axes and forward-curving hook blades, composite bows with copper-tipped arrows, hide or copper helmets, small round shields, with copper scale armour reserved for the nobility and the guard; the chariotry used light two-wheeled cars on six-spoked wooden wheels drawn by a single pair of horses, with composite bows, a spear and a short sword carried on board. Siege equipment is recorded in the reliefs of this series as well: wheeled siege towers, lever-operated battering rams and saps cut under the base of a wall, which places Egyptian siegecraft among the earliest in the Mediterranean. Steppe powers such as Nuhašše relied on the horse bow, light equipment and mobility, with few chariots and little heavy infantry, so their answer was to move, plunder and avoid the set-piece clash.
tactics: 第十三次遠征的戰法是敲打而不是攻城。圖特摩斯三世的北方政策在第九次之後已經定型：主力不打到幼發拉底河，也不去攻大城，而是以一支快速車隊加輕裝步兵的縱隊，選在春末至初夏的窗口自迦薩或耶路撒冷一線北進，掃過約旦河東岸的牧場與驛道，逼迫游牧首領率部眾與牲畜退避，然後帶走一批人畜作為貢賦與人質，退回埃及。避免在旱季拉長補給線是這套動作的關鍵：糧食由尼羅河船運送到卡爾納克與邊境倉，沙漠段靠駱駝隊與驢車，缺水時只能沿古道的水窖與井宿營，因此遠征多在洪水退去、收穫未至的季節收尾。若對方集結武裝，埃及的應對是先以弓手封住退路，由車兵在兩翼壓制，把對方趕向缺水地帶，再以持矛兵與佩月牙劍的近衛壓上去結束戰鬥；近衛所用的正是這件不必拔刃的單刃劍，在狹窄地形與散兵之中比直劍好使。只有在奪城時才用撞錘與攻城塔，並且先切斷城外的耕地與水井，逼守軍出城。對付草原游牧武裝則另有章法：車隊不深入追擊，只在水源與驛道沿線截擊，把對方逼出牧地，再以繳獲牲畜與扣押人首領作為收束。至於王室層面，遠征的結果必須被寫成儀式：獻俘、逐項登記繳獲、頌詞刻入卡爾納克牆面，這套儀式把每一次小隊突擊都固定成一項法老的功業。
tacticsEn: The method of the thirteenth campaign was a beating, not a siege. By the ninth campaign the northern policy of Thutmose III had settled into a fixed shape: the main body did not strike as far as the Euphrates and did not lay siege to great cities, but a column of fast chariots with light infantry moved north from the Gaza or Jerusalem line in the window of the late spring and early summer, sweeping the pastures and caravan tracks on the east bank of the Jordan, driving the nomadic chiefs away with their herds and beasts, and then taking away a number of people and cattle as tribute and hostages before falling back to Egypt. Keeping the supply line short in the dry season was the key to this operation: grain came down the Nile by ship to Karnak and the frontier depots, the desert leg was covered by camel train and donkey cart, and in the absence of water the column could only bivouac at the cisterns and wells of the old tracks, so the expeditions were timed to close before the floods had failed and before the harvest, when rations were still short. If the enemy armed bands did assemble, the Egyptian answer was to close the line of retreat with archers first, to press with the chariots on both wings, to drive the enemy towards ground without water, and then to close with spearmen and the guard carrying khopeshes; the weapon the guard used was exactly that single-edged sword which need not be withdrawn, and it served better than a straight sword in broken ground and among scattered men. The ram and the siege tower were brought up only for the taking of a city, and even then the fields and wells outside the walls were cut first to force the garrison out. Against the steppe war-bands there was a separate repertoire: the chariots did not pursue deep, but struck along the water sources and the caravan roads, driving the enemy off the grazing lands, and the operation was closed by taking cattle and the chiefs' sons as prize. At the level of the court, the result of an expedition had to be written up as a rite: prisoners presented, booty itemised, the victory hymn cut into the walls of Karnak, and that rite fixed every small raid into one more work of the pharaoh.
data: 可核對的數字有幾組。其一是編號與年代：卡爾納克神廟的名單列有圖特摩斯三世的編號遠征，最後一次由孟菲斯的將軍霍倫海布墓中自述補上，合為十七次；第十三次落在王曆三十八年，約公元前一四四一年，屬他五十餘年在位期的中段。其二是系列中相鄰的幾場：第九次在王曆三十四年，目標同樣是努哈謝，記錄的繳獲極少，可判定為一次小規模襲擊；第十次在王曆三十五年，米坦尼集結大軍在阿勒頗一帶與埃及交戰，卡爾納克年表只記下十名俘虜，戰後赫梯送來貢物；第十一次推定在王曆三十六年，第十二次在三十七年，第十四次在三十九年，目標是沙蘇人，位置無從確定，第十四次之後的編號落進缺文，只能靠年代推算。其三是距離與行軍：自孟菲斯經卡爾納克與西奈商道到迦薩約九百公里，再由迦薩經耶路撒冷下約旦河谷約兩百公里，沙漠段每日行程約二十五至三十公里，車隊由邊境走到約旦河東岸須兩至三週。其四是規模：按新王國野戰編制推算，遠征兵力在數千至一萬上下，車隊以數百輛計，單次繳獲的馬匹、銅器、金銀器皿、象牙與戰車，量級在數十至數百件。其五是那段貢賦抄本：緊接第十三次之前留存的，是第十二次的部分清單，所記為野獸與幾種尚不能確定的礦物，有人據此推測第十二次的地點在努哈謝一帶的草原，但這只是推測。
dataEn: There are several groups of figures that can be checked. First, the numbering and the dates: the list at the temple of Karnak records the numbered expeditions of Thutmose III, and the last of them is supplied by the autobiography carved in the tomb of the general Horemheb at Memphis, making seventeen in all; the thirteenth falls in regnal year 38, that is about 1441 BC, in the middle stretch of a reign of more than fifty years. Second, the neighbouring campaigns in the series: the ninth, in regnal year 34, had Nuhašše as its object as well and recorded a minimum of plunder, which marks it as a small raid; the tenth, in regnal year 35, saw Mitanni raise a large army and engage the Egyptians around Aleppo, the Karnak annals recording a total of ten prisoners of war, and the Hatti sent tribute afterwards; the eleventh is placed in regnal year 36 and the twelfth in year 37, while the fourteenth, in year 39, was against the Shasu, whose position cannot be determined, and after that the numbering falls into lacunae and can only be counted by date. Third, distances and marching: from Memphis by way of Karnak and the caravan roads of Sinai to Gaza is about nine hundred kilometres, and from Gaza through Jerusalem down into the Jordan valley some two hundred more, with the desert leg covering twenty-five to thirty kilometres a day, so that a chariot column needed two to three weeks to reach the east bank from the Egyptian border. Fourth, scale: judged from the field organisation of the New Kingdom, the expedition numbered in the thousands up to about ten thousand men, with the chariot force counted in hundreds of vehicles, while the horses, copper, gold and silver vessels, ivory and chariots taken in a single campaign ran to tens or hundreds of items. Fifth is that fragment of the tribute list: what survives immediately before the thirteenth campaign is part of the list of the twelfth, and it records wild game and certain minerals that cannot yet be identified, from which some have inferred that the twelfth campaign took place on the steppe around Nuhašše, though that remains a conjecture.
cause: 打起來的緣由有兩層。第一層是眼前的：努哈謝地區聚居著半遊牧人口，佔據約旦河東岸的牧場、水源與商隊往來的驛道，這些人馬不屬於米坦尼的城邦體系，也不服埃及在阿姆吉的駐軍管理，時常南下擾亂商旅與牧場，埃及必須用遠征一次、敲打一次，讓地方首領認得邊界在哪裡。第二層是長期的：米坦尼並未被消滅，聯盟內的城邦在阿姆吉、阿拉達等地反覆叛離又反覆歸附，埃及無法用一次會戰解決黎凡特，只能靠年年出征、按年表記功的制度維持宗主權；每一次遠征都要帶回人質、歲貢與繳獲，好讓北方諸邦明白秩序由誰來畫。第十三次正是這套制度運作到成熟期的一次例行動作：法老把年表上的第十三次與北方草原的一次邊境清理合為一場戰爭，既補上了對邊境的管理，也為卡爾納克的紀錄添上一行。
causeEn: The reasons for fighting come in two layers. The first is immediate: the region of Nuhašše was inhabited by semi-nomadic people who held the pastures, the water and the caravan tracks of the east bank of the Jordan; these bands did not belong to the city-state system of Mitanni and did not accept the administration of the Egyptian garrison in Amurru, and they moved south to harry the caravans and the grazing lands, so Egypt had to march north once and hit out once, to make the local chiefs see where the border lay. The second layer is the long one: Mitanni had not been destroyed, the cities of the league rebelled and returned again and again at places such as Amurru and Ardata, and Egypt could not settle the Levant with a single battle; it could only hold the suzerainty with an institutional system of annual expeditions, written into the regnal annals, each of them bringing back hostages, tribute and booty so that the northern states would understand who was drawing the order of things. The thirteenth campaign is a routine action of that system at its mature stage: the pharaoh made a numbering in the annals and a clearance of the northern steppe into a single war, filling the gap in the frontier administration and adding one more line to the record at Karnak.
impact: 第十三次本身沒有改變地圖，它的影響主要在制度與後續。第一，埃及在約旦河東岸始終沒有建立永久據點：努哈謝在第九次與第十三次都被記為邊境上的小規模行動，之後再沒有出現於圖特摩斯三世的編號遠征名單；這條東線實際上長期游離在埃及版圖之外，直到赫梯取代米坦尼、直接支配敘利亞才換了主人。第二，這一系遠征把埃及的北方統治變成一種儀式化的行政：貢賦清單、人質、界線名單，以及卡爾納克牆面上的頌詞，把年年出征的要求變成年年都要記上一功的形式；正因為儀式先行，埃及對黎凡特的實際控制遠比年表所宣稱的有限。第三，軍備上的變化也在這個階段定型：月牙劍到第十八王朝中葉仍是近衛的標準配備，但步兵中直刃雙鋒劍已開始取代它；待到第十九王朝，這種外彎的單刃劍成為謝爾登等海上民族的標誌性武器，並隨戰利品與俘虜向敘利亞與地中海東岸擴散。第四，遠征的高潮在王曆四十二年之前的最後一次亞洲戰役後結束，第十五次、第十六次之後便轉向努比亞；王曆五十年他最後一次用兵是在尼羅河的第四瀑布，公元前一千四百二十五年他去世，第十八王朝的北方政策自此收縮，直到拉美西斯二世在卡爾德什與赫梯開戰，敘利亞的歸屬才被徹底重畫。
impactEn: The thirteenth campaign changed no map of its own; its effects run along lines of institution and sequel. First, Egypt never established a permanent post on the east bank of the Jordan: Nuhašše appears in the record as a minor operation on the frontier at the ninth and again at the thirteenth campaign, and then it does not reappear in the numbered expeditions of Thutmose III. That eastern line in practice long floated outside the Egyptian map, and only when the Hatti replaced Mitanni and took the lordship of Syria directly did it change hands. Second, this series of expeditions turned the Egyptian administration of the north into a ritualised affair: tribute lists, hostages, lists of boundaries and the victory hymns on the walls of Karnak turned the requirement of campaigning every year into the requirement of scoring a success every year; and precisely because the ritual came first, the real Egyptian control over the Levant was far thinner than the annals claimed. Third, the evolution of arms was settled in this same stretch: the khopesh was still the standard weapon of the guard in the middle of the Eighteenth Dynasty, but straight double-edged swords were already replacing it in the infantry; by the Nineteenth Dynasty this outward-curved single-edged sword had become the signature weapon of the Sherden and other sea peoples, and it spread with loot and prisoners towards Syria and the eastern Mediterranean. Fourth, the series of expeditions closed after the last Asian campaign before regnal year 42, and after the fifteenth and sixteenth the king turned to Nubia; his last campaign, in regnal year 50, was carried to the fourth cataract of the Nile, and he died in 1425 BC, after which the foreign policy of the Eighteenth Dynasty contracted, until Ramesses II fought the Hatti at Qadesh and the ownership of Syria was redrawn altogether.
result: 打完的結果，是一場沒有大戰的邊界動作。卡爾納克的年表在第十二次那段殘缺的貢賦抄本之後，只簡短地記下王曆三十八年、目的地努哈謝的一行；沒有攻城記錄，沒有大戰記載，繳獲的數目也不多，說明這一趟是掃蕩半遊牧武裝、截取牲畜與扣押人質、迫使地方首領俯首的動作，而不是攻下了一座城。埃及沒有因此取得永久的土地，聯盟的城邦也沒有因此被改組，北方線的均勢維持不變，埃及靠年年到來的巡行與徵貢維持事實上的宗主權，而圖特摩斯三世照例把這場邊境清理寫成一次成功，編號繼續往下排：第十四次對沙蘇人，第十五次、第十六次，第十七次之後才是那場對努比亞的遠征。整體來看，這是十七次敘利亞遠征中的一次標準動作：沒有決定性的勝負，也沒有可以長久駐紮的據點，留下來的只有繳獲、人質與年表上的一行字；直到拉美西斯二世在卡爾德什與赫梯開戰，這條北方戰線才真正被重新畫過。
resultEn: The outcome was a boundary action without a great battle. In the annals of Karnak, after the broken tribute list of the twelfth campaign, there is only a short line recording regnal year 38 and the destination Nuhašše; there is no record of a siege, no account of a pitched battle, and the tally of booty is small, which shows that this was a sweep against semi-nomadic armed bands, a taking of cattle and of hostages to bend the local chiefs, not the capture of a city. Egypt gained no lasting territory from it and the city-states of the league were not reorganised; the balance on the northern line remained as it was, and Egypt kept a working suzerainty through the yearly visit and the yearly collection of tribute, while Thutmose III entered this clearance of the frontier as a success like any other and the numbering went on: the fourteenth against the Shasu, the fifteenth, the sixteenth, and after the seventeenth came the expedition to Nubia. Taken as a whole this is one standard move in the seventeen Syrian expeditions: no decisive result, no post that could be held, nothing left behind but booty, hostages and one line in the annals. It was not until Ramesses II fought the Hatti at Qadesh that this northern front was genuinely drawn again.
